title: Commercial Fusion Energy 2026: From Experimental Physics to Qualified Plant
subtitle: Six of nine ITER sector modules are in the pit and $14.24B is private capital, but no closed tritium cycle, qualified alloy or fusion licence exists yet.

current_gaps.title: Net Gain Unproven
current_gaps.spec: No net energy gain; NIF alone exceeds Q>1; engineering breakeven unmet

current_gaps.title: Tritium Cycle Open
current_gaps.spec: No breeding-blanket TBR data; 12.3-year half-life, no reprocessing protocol

current_gaps.title: Materials Unqualified
current_gaps.spec: No fusion neutron source qualifying structural alloys to a stated dpa

current_gaps.title: Funding Discontinuity
current_gaps.spec: FES FY2027 appropriated $790M vs $805.7M enacted; no multi-year budget line

current_gaps.title: Licensing Void
current_gaps.spec: No fusion-specific licensing rule; byproduct-material pathways undefined

evolution_matrix.key_upgrade: Replaces between-shot operator retuning with ML shift-prediction frameworks validated at DIII-D.
Replaces mined tritium inventory with lithium breeding blankets closing the 12.3-year half-life cycle.
Replaces fission-derived alloy qualification with a dedicated fusion neutron irradiation facility.
Replaces ad-hoc lifts with millimetre-tolerance metrology sequences; ITER drove a module lift to 30 hours.
Replaces fission-equivalent licensing with fusion-specific byproduct-material regulation and permitting.

core_pillars.title: Plasma Control
core_pillars.concise_spec: Real-time 1 kHz equilibrium reconstruction, ML shot prediction, 30 s burn control

core_pillars.title: Tritium Fuel Cycle
core_pillars.concise_spec: Closed lithium blanket loop, ≥1.05 TBR, 12.3-year tritium inventory control

core_pillars.title: Material Qualification
core_pillars.concise_spec: Neutron-resistant alloys and tungsten PFCs; dpa tolerance unpublished

core_pillars.title: Assembly & Maintenance
core_pillars.concise_spec: 440-tonne sectors; 30-hour lifts; ≤1 mm alignment; 9 modules by mid-2027

core_pillars.title: Licensing & Finance
core_pillars.concise_spec: FES $790M FY2027; $4.48B private 12 months; licence pathway undefined

expansion_stages.label: Single Device
expansion_stages.detail: Digital twin and shot model tuned on one machine before export.

expansion_stages.label: Test Bench
expansion_stages.detail: Rep-rate and plasma-facing-component erosion campaign at Electra-class laser.

expansion_stages.label: Sector Campaign
expansion_stages.detail: Metrology-sequenced assembly; 4 Korean and 5 European vacuum vessel sectors.

expansion_stages.label: Fleet
expansion_stages.detail: Shared material qualification and licensing dossiers ahead of mid-2030s grid connection.

validation_benches.title: Burn Control
validation_benches.test_criteria: Pass if 1 kHz equilibrium control holds stored energy within ±1% for 30 s.

validation_benches.title: Tritium Loop
validation_benches.test_criteria: Pass if blanket yields ≥1 bred tritium per burnt tritium over 1 campaign.

validation_benches.title: Sector Metrology
validation_benches.test_criteria: Pass if module 9 aligns to ≤1 mm and leaves the hall in ≤30 h.

validation_benches.title: Funding Ramp
validation_benches.test_criteria: Pass if FY2027 FES appropriation reaches ≥$1.1B authorised ceiling.
